title: Fun and informative tour!
text: Our guide Steven was funny & charismatic, we are thankful that we had him all to ourselves for this tour. We were somewhat aware of the rich culture & history Barcelona possessed but Steven opened our eyes to the history behind the architects & the architecture of the buildings we have come to know today. The tour was insightful and a lovely way to explore the city beyond the usual touristy spots. Steven also introduced us to TKO tacos (1 euro for a taco!) after our last stop at Sagrada and he kindly obliged to have lunch with us. The tour was well paced and we highly recommend this tour to an
author: Paradise55017912852

title: Antonio’s Modernista tour of Barcelona
text: Antonio is a wonderful guide: friendly, knowledgeable, and interesting. We enjoyed his discussion of Barcelona’s history and architecture. He actually spent more than the allotted time with us, and we appreciated his modification of the route due to my partner’s mobility issues. I highly recommend Antonio’s tour.
author: terrypL7883NE

title: Fun and super passionate tour of modernist Barcelona with Stephanie
text: Stephanie is an amazing guide (PhD in architecture and history) - passionate, witty, charismatic and knowledgeable. She went above and beyond to tell us as much about modernist Barcelona as she possibly could. We learnt so much about Barcelona and beyond - highly recommend this tour!!
author: keyw1z

title: The tour takes one to...
text: The tour takes one to important (and beautiful!) Modernist landmarks. Standing in front of the Music Palace and some of the houses designed by Gaudi was a thrilling experience. Our guide was professional and friendly and knew so much about the subject of the tour. He transmitted admiration and understanding of Gaudi and his work.
author: Mayra_O

title: Great Walk Around
text: Great knowledge sharing as you walk through the modernist architecture and learn the history of Barcelona as well as Gaudi. Jose Carlos was a superb guide-very knowledgeable & accommodating to his clients.
author: Irene_K

title: Antonio’s walking tour is the best!
text: This is an extremely well researched and explained experience. Antonio the guide is knowledgeable and passionate about the subject and fun to be with.. 11 out of 10.!
author: Brenda_R

title: Thanks Montse

title: Montse in Barcelona is well worth the time
text: Montse was fantastic! We spent several hours with her discovering the beautiful history and architecture of Barcelona. She was knowledgeable,  friendly, and quite professional. We had a wonderful experience.
author: L2622OZjend

title: Great tour by Stephanie
text: Excellent walking tour of modernisme architecture of Barcelona  with tour guide Stephanie , an art and architecture expert.Stephanie showed me all the landmark buildings as well as the lesser known ones and added a tour of the historic area where I was staying . Stephanie was personable , informative and enthusiastic . A pure delight!
author: R7482SCchristinef

title: Detailed tour of beautiful Barcelona
text: Isabel was such a fun and energetic guide! We were a family of 10 and she took us on a private tour to see the most famous Gaudi houses including the Sagrada Família. She never rushed us even when the kids were getting hungry and wanted a snack, she had us stop for lunch, which was delish! She not only gave us a guided tour, she shared so much history about Barcelona with us. It really enriched our time in the city and our understanding of the history. She even gave us more recommendations before we ended.
author: 741bernicef
